label: Rule and ring relations
title: Whole-state rule relations expose ring effects, but arithmetic correlations shift
summary: An extensible instrument compares whole-state partitions across eight rules and thirteen ring sizes. Of 27 selected arithmetic associations, four retain their sign, 21 reverse and two become undefined on held-out sizes.
takeaway: Preserve complete relations and arithmetic support; the strongest small-ring correlations need not transfer to a new size range.
